entries.title: Romans 16:1
segments: ¶But I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is minister of the assembly which is in Cenchrea;

entries.title: Romans 16:2
segments: that ye may receive her in [the] Lord worthily of saints, and that ye may assist her in whatever matter she has need of you; for *she* also has been a helper of many, and of myself.

entries.title: Romans 16:3
segments: Salute Prisca and Aquila, my fellow-workmen in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Romans 16:4
segments: (who for my life staked their own neck; to whom not *I* only am thankful, but also all the assemblies of the nations,)

entries.title: Romans 16:5
segments: and the assembly at their house. Salute Epaenetus, my beloved, who is [the] first-fruits of Asia for Christ.

entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: Salute Maria, who laboured much for you.

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and fellow-captives, who are of note among the apostles; who were also in Christ before me.

entries.title: Romans 16:8
segments: Salute Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:9
segments: Salute Urbanus, our fellow-workman in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

entries.title: Romans 16:10
segments: Salute Apelles, approved in Christ. Salute those who belong to Aristobulus.

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: Salute Herodion, my kinsman. Salute those who belong to Narcissus, who are in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labour in [the] Lord. Salute Persis, the beloved, who has laboured much in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: Salute Rufus, chosen in [the] Lord; and his mother and mine.

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:16
segments: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the assemblies of Christ salute you.

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: ¶But I beseech you, brethren, to consider those who create divisions and occasions of falling, contrary to the doctrine which *ye* have learnt, and turn away from them.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: For such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly, and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments: For your obedience has reached to all. I rejoice therefore as it regards you; but I wish you to be wise [as] to that which is good, and simple [as] to evil.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments: But the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

entries.title: Romans 16:21
segments: ¶Timotheus, my fellow-workman, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: I Tertius, who have written this epistle, salute you in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:23
segments: Gaius, my host and of the whole assembly, salutes you. Erastus, the steward of the city, salutes you, and the brother Quartus.

entries.title: Romans 16:24
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments: ¶Now to him that is able to establish you, according to my glad tidings and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to [the] revelation of [the] mystery, as to which silence has been kept in [the] times of the ages,

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: but [which] has now been made manifest, and by prophetic scriptures, according to commandment of the eternal God, made known for obedience of faith to all the nations--

entries.title: Romans 16:27
segments: [the] only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
